about: The author explains why the king of Persia is of Shem's seed by retelling Genesis 38: Judah's two sons, the second refusing the levirate duty and struck dead by God, Tamar's disguise as a harlot and the pledges of staff, ring and cap, Judah's verdict that she is more righteous than he, and the birth of the twins Perez and Zerah. Persia is said to be named for Perez, whose line reigned there.

sentences.l: And-king-of Persia-also seed-of Shem he, and-that-which concerning-him we-will-inform-you.
sentences.i: Now the king of Persia is also of the seed of Shem, and we shall make known to you what concerns him.
sentences.n: ወ- 'and' opens the unit; -ኒ on ፋርስኒ is an enclitic 'also, indeed', carrying on from the Babylonian line of the previous chapter. ዘርአ ሴም is a construct chain, 'seed-of Shem': Shem is Noah's son, and the claim is that the Persian kings descend from him. ውእቱ is the pronoun 'he' used as the copula, 'he (is)'. ወዘበእንቲአሁ is ወ + ዘ ('that which') + በእንቲአሁ ('concerning him', በእንተ with the suffix -ሁ in its connecting-vowel form); it is the object of the verb, 'that which concerns him'. ናየድዐክሙ 'we shall inform you' is a 1st-plural imperfect of the causative stem (ʾa-stem) of ydʿ with the object suffix -ክሙ 'you (pl.)'; I take the root so, but the verb is not one I could confirm in Dillmann by sight (?).

sentences.l: And-he-begot Judah two sons, and-he-brought-in for-him Tamar-her to-who he-is-older his-son;
sentences.i: Judah had two sons, and he gave Tamar in marriage to the elder of them;
sentences.n: The story is Genesis 38, the account of Judah and Tamar, told here with the names of Er and Onan left out: 'the older' is Er and 'the younger' (next unit) is Onan, implicit only. ወለደ 'he begot' is a plain 3ms perfect; ይሁዳ (Judah) is the subject after the verb. ክልኤ ደቂቀ is 'two' + the accusative plural of ወልድ 'son'. ወአእተወ is the causative (ʾa-stem) of አተወ 'enter': 'he caused to enter', i.e. brought her in as a bride; ሎቱ 'for him' anticipates ለዘ ይልህቅ ወልዲ ('for him, for the elder, his son'). ትዕማርሃ has a resumptive suffix -ሃ 'her' on the name, which I read as redundant (?). ለዘ ይልህቅ ወልዲ is 'to the one who is the elder, (his) son'; ዘ is the relative 'who', ይልህቅ 'he is grown/great'. The spelling ወልዲ is odd (expected ወልዱ 'his son'); I read it as 'his son' (?).

sentences.i: The elder died, and Judah sent the younger son to her, to raise up offspring for his brother by his brother's wife.
sentences.n: The subject changes without a name: ሞተ 'he died' is the elder son; ፈነዎ 'he sent him' has Judah as its implied subject and -ዎ 'him' as object, re-stated by ለዘ ይንእስ ወልዲ 'the younger son' (ለ- marks the object here, 'to-who he-is-young'). ከመ ያቅም 'that he raise up' is ከመ + a subjunctive of the causative (ʾa-stem) of ቆመ 'stand': 'make stand, establish'. This is the levirate duty of Deuteronomy 25:5-10: a surviving brother must raise up seed for the dead one. ለእኁሁ 'for his brother' (እኁ + -ሁ); ኀበ ብእሲቱ እኁሁ 'with the wife of his brother': ብእሲቱ carries the suffix -ሁ ('his wife', not the construct ብእሲተ), with the owner added after it, 'his wife, his brother's'.

sentences.l: And-he-also did what he-hates God, and-not-he-wished that he-raise-up seed for-his-brother as he-commanded-him his-father Judah; and-he-indeed, when he-lies with Tamar, he-brings-out his-seed to the-ground, that not-it-be-held in womb-of hers and-not it-be-called seed-of his-brother;
sentences.i: And he too did what God hates: he did not want to raise up offspring for his brother, as his father Judah had commanded him. Whenever he lay with Tamar he let his seed go out onto the ground, so that it would not be held in her womb and not be called the seed of his brother;
sentences.n: This is Onan (Genesis 38:8-10), still unnamed. ወውእቱኒ is ወ + ውእቱ 'he' + ኒ 'also'; ውእቱሰ later has the contrastive -ሰ 'but, for his part'. ዘይጸልእ እግዚኣብሔር is a relative clause, 'that which God hates' (ዘ + imperfect ይጸልእ). ወኢፈቀደ is ኢ- 'not' + perfect ፈቀደ 'wished'. በከመ 'as' + አዘዞ 'he commanded him'. ሶበ ይሰክብ 'when he lies' is ሶበ + imperfect, here meaning 'whenever'; ያወፅእ is the causative of ወፅአ 'go out' (ʾa-stem): 'he brings out'. ዘርኦ is ዘርእ + -ኦ, the accusative form of ዘርኡ 'his seed' (object of ያወፅእ). Passive-type verbs: ኢይትዐቈር is the tä-stem (reflexive/passive) of ዐቈረ, 'be held, kept (in)' (?); ኢይሰመይ is the passive of ሰምየ 'name', 'be called'. ከርሠ ዚአሃ 'womb of hers': ዚአሃ is the possessive 'of her'.

sentences.i: but he wanted to raise up offspring from his wife in his own name;
sentences.n: አላ 'but' sets his real wish against the duty. ይፈቅድ is the plain imperfect 'he wishes', used for his settled intent. እምብእሲቱ 'from his wife' is እም- 'from' + ብእሲት + -ሁ; the 'wife' is Tamar, who would be his own by the arrangement. በስመ ዚአሁ 'in name-of his-own': በ- 'in', ስመ in the construct state, ዚአሁ the independent possessive 'his own'. The point of the law was that a child be reckoned to the dead brother, not to the living one.

sentences.i: And God saw the evil of his deeds, turned his face from him, and killed him.
sentences.n: ወርእዮ is the gerund of ርእየ 'see' with ወ-: 'and seeing (he)', the subject being God, i.e. 'God having seen'. -ዮ here is the ending of the gerund, not an object suffix; the verb that follows is the main one. እከየ is the construct of እከይ 'evil' ('the evil of his deeds', object of the gerund). ምግባሪሁ 'his deeds' is ምግባር 'deed, doing' with -ሁ in its connecting-vowel form. ሜጠ ገጾ 'he turned his face' I take as withdrawing favour (?); ወቀተሎ 'and he killed him' (ቀተለ + -ኦ 'him'). sentences.i: Judah, her father-in-law, sent Tamar back, and brought her into her father's house, and said to her kinsfolk: Keep this Israelite woman, and do not defile her with another man, for I have a young child; if God makes him grow up, I shall give her to him.
sentences.n: ወአግብኣ is the causative (ʾa-stem) of ገብአ 'return' with -ኣ 'her': 'he made her return'. ሐሙሃ 'her father-in-law' (ሐም + -ሃ) stands in apposition to ይሁዳ, and ለትዕማር repeats the object. ወአእተዋ is 'and he brought her in' (causative of አተወ 'enter'). ለአዝማዲሃ 'to her kinsfolk': አዝማድ is the plural of ዘመድ 'kinsman', with -ሃ 'her'. Imperatives: ዕቀብዋ 'keep her' (2mp imperative, with -ዋ 'her'; ለዛቲ እስራኤላዊት 'this Israelite woman' repeats the object with ለ-), ወኢታርኵስዋ 'and do not defile her' (ኢ- + 2mp jussive of the causative of ረኵሰ 'be unclean'); ኀበ ባዕድ is 'to/with another (man)'. ንኡሰ ሕፃነ is 'a small child' (two accusatives, adjective and noun). ብየ is 'there is to me' (ብ- 'there is' + የ 'me'), the Geʿez way to say 'I have'. This younger child is Shelah of Genesis 38:11, whom the text leaves unnamed. ለእመ 'if'; አልሀቆ 'he makes him grow' (causative of ልህቀ (the text writes ሀ)) and እሁቦ ኪያሃ 'I give him her' (ኪያሃ is the independent object pronoun 'her').

sentences.n: ወትዕማርሰ: ወ- + name + -ሰ, the contrastive 'but Tamar for her part'. ሰምዐት, ገደፈት, ሖረት, ነበረት are all 3fs perfects (ending -ት). ገደፈት እምላዕሌሃ is 'she threw off from upon her'; አልባሰ ምዕስብና is a construct chain, 'garments-of widowhood', as is አልባሰ ክብር 'garments-of honour' (fine, splendid clothes). ተረሰየት is the tä-stem of ረሰየ 'set, make': 'she made herself up, was arrayed'. ተገልበበት is a tä-stem of the four-letter ገልበበ 'wrap, cover' (?); the text names no veil, so the English does not. ዘማት 'harlot' (here and below) may be a feminine singular or a plural used generically (?); every use reads as 'harlot'. Compare Genesis 38:14-15, where she veils her face and sits where Judah will pass. በአምሳለ ዘማት 'in the likeness of a harlot'. The last clause, ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ, is unclear: I take እንተ as the feminine relative with an omitted noun, 'she went (to the place) which (is) behind him', so 'after him' (?).

Tamar's father is given as አቡሃ ለትዕማር 'her father, of Tamar'. አቅርብ is the imperative of the causative of ቀርበ, 'bring near'; ሊተ 'to me'; ወለትከ 'your daughter' (ወለት + -ከ); ፅንስተ is the accusative of ፅንስት, 'pregnant (woman)'. ንውግራ 'that we stone her' is 1cp subjunctive of ወገረ 'stone' + -ኣ 'her'. The odd split in በአእባ ፡ ን is one word, በአእባን 'with stones' (አእባን, plural of እብን); it is written whole at the end of unit 22. Stoning for unchastity: Deuteronomy 22:20-24 (the text names Moses as the lawgiver); in Genesis 38:24 the penalty is burning. አኅሰረት is the causative of ኀሰረ 'lack' so 'she has made lack, brought loss to' (?); ቤተ እስራኤል 'house-of Israel'.

sentences.i: She brought out the ring, the staff, and the cap, gave them to her father and her kinsfolk, and said to them: The owner of these is the one who led me astray; and let them stone me with him, with stones.
sentences.n: አውፅአት is the causative of ወፅአ ('go out'), so 'she brought out'. She gives back the three items of Judah's pledge. ባዕለ ዝንቱአ: ባዕል 'owner, master' (here the construct before ዝንቱ 'this') and the odd final አ on ዝንቱአ, which I take as an enclitic on ዝንቱ, 'this one' (?). ዘአስሐተኒ is 'he who made me err': a relative ዘ + the causative of ሰሐተ 'err' + -ኒ 'me', i.e. 'seduced' (?). ወይውግሩኒ is 'and they stone me': 3mp imperfect of ወግረ + -ኒ, here read as a challenge or consequence, 'let them' (?). This is Genesis 38:25, where she sends the objects with the words 'by the man to whom these belong I am with child.'

glossary.ለአዝማዲሃ: ዘመድ — to her kinsfolk (ለ- + plural አዝማድ 'kinsfolk' + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
glossary.ለእኁሁ: አኅ — to/for his brother (ለ- + noun, base እኁ- + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
glossary.ለዛቲ: ዛቲ — to this, of this (ለ- + fem. demonstrative ዛቲ before ትውልድ)
glossary.ለይኩን: ኮነ — let it be (ለ- jussive particle + 3ms jussive ይኩን, k-w-n)
glossary.ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
glossary.ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ) · 'to her' (ይሰግዱ ላቲ 'they bow to her', ch. 55) · ለ — after ያፈቅር, 'he loves her, is fond of her' (ያፈቅር ላቲ; ለ- marking the object, with -ቲ '3fs')
glossary.ሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — people (noun; predicate accusative) · people of (construct, ሕዝበ እግዚኣብሔር 'people of God', ሕዝበ እስራኤል 'people of Israel') · accusative in apposition to መንታ: ክልኤተ ሕዝበ 'two peoples' (the twins as heads of lines) (?) · or construct 'the two peoples of Perez and Zerah' (ክልኤተ ሕዝበ ፋሬስ ወዛራ) (?)
glossary.መላህቅተ: መልህቅ — anchor (plural መላህቅት; construct መላህቅተ, subject here); here figuratively 'stays, elders', the sense taken from context, 'elders of' (?) · or construct plural of ልሂቅ 'elder', 'elders of'
glossary.መጽአ: መጽአ — he/it came (3ms perfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ማሕስአ: ማሕስአ — unknown word, apparently a young animal of the flock; meaning from context (?)
glossary.ሜጠ: ሜጠ — he turned (3ms perfect, G; root m-y-ṭ)
glossary.ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
glossary.ምዕስብና: ምዕስብና — widowhood (abstract noun; dependent on አልባሰ, አልባሰ ምዕስብና 'garments of widowhood') (?)
glossary.ምግባሪሁ: ምግባር — his deeds (noun, deed, work + -ሁ '3ms his' in the connecting-vowel form -ሪሁ)
glossary.በስመ: ስም — by the name of (በ- 'by, in' + construct 'name of')
glossary.በትረ: በትር — rod, staff (construct 'rod of') · also accusative 'rod(s)' after a number (ሠለስተ በትረ 'three rods')
glossary.በአልባሰ: ልብስ — in garments of (በ- + plural አልባስ, construct 'garments of')
glossary.በአምሳለ: አምሳል — in the likeness of (በ- + noun, construct አምሳለ)
glossary.በአእባ: እብን — with stones (በ- + plural አእባን; first half of በአእባን, split by a stray wordspace)
glossary.በአእባን: እብን — with stones (በ- + noun, plural አእባን)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.ባዕለ: ባዕል — owner, lord (noun; construct 'owner of') · accusative predicate 'rich' (ወኮነ ባዕለ ጥቀ 'he became exceedingly rich'; 'powerful' is also possible (?))
glossary.ባዕድ: ባዕድ — another, a stranger (adjective/noun; ብእሲተ ባዕድ 'another man's wife') · 'strange, foreign' (አማልክተ ባዕድ 'strange gods')
glossary.ብእሲቱ: ብእሲት — his wife (noun + -u 'his') · 'his wife' with the owner added after it (ብእሲቱ እኁሁ 'his wife, his brother's'; not the construct ብእሲተ)
glossary.ተዐውቀ: ዐወቀ — it was/has become known (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ዐወቀ 'know' (?); rendered as a present 'it is known')
glossary.ትነብር: ነበረ — she dwells, sits (3fs imperfect, n-b-r)
glossary.ትዕማርሃ: ትዕማር — Tamar (proper name + -ሃ '3fs her', read as a redundant resumptive suffix) (?)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀቤሃ: ኀበ — to her, toward her (preposition ኀበ + -ሃ '3fs') · 'with, beside' (እንተ ኀቤሃ 'who were with her', ch. 55)
glossary.ኅድጉአ: ኀደገ — leave it! (2mp imperative, G + -ኣ 'it, 3fs', spelled -አ) (?)
glossary.ነግሀ: ነግህ — dawn (noun, accusative ነግሀ, used adverbially 'at dawn') (?); also 3ms perfect ነግሀ 'it dawned'
glossary.ናየድዐክሙ: አየድዐ — we shall inform you (1cp imperfect, ʾa-stem causative of y-d-ʿ + -ክሙ '2mp you') (?)
glossary.ን: እብን — -ን, second half of በአእባን 'with stones', split off by a stray wordspace
glossary.ንዋዮ: ንዋይ — his goods, property (noun, accusative + -ሁ '3ms his', ንዋዮ)
glossary.ንውግራ: ወገረ — that we stone her (1cp subjunctive, G + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አልሀቆ: አልሀቀ — he makes him grow (3ms perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ልህቀ 'grow' + -ኦ '3ms him'; perfect in a conditional ለእመ 'if')
glossary.አልባሰ: ልብስ — garments, clothes (plural አልባስ, accusative) · construct 'garments of' (አልባሰ ምዕስብና 'garments of widowhood')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አቅርብ: አቀረበ — bring near, bring forward (2ms imperative, ʾa-stem causative of ቀርበ, q-r-b)
glossary.አኅሰረት: አኅሰረ — she has caused loss, diminished (3fs perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ኀሰረ 'lack') (?)
glossary.አእመረ: አእመረ — know, come to know (3ms perfect, ʾa-stem, not a true causative)
glossary.አዕጻ: ዐጸድ — first half of አዕጻ ፡ ዳተ, read as one word አዕጻዳት 'folds, enclosures' (plural of ዐጸድ, construct 'folds of'), split by a stray wordspace (?)
glossary.ኢይትዐቈር: ተዐቈረ — that it not be held, retained (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive, tä-stem passive of ዐቈረ) (?)
glossary.እሁቦ: ወሀበ — I will give him (1cs imperfect + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.እምላዕሌሃ: ላዕል — from upon her (እም- + ላዕሌ- 'upon' + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.እምብእሲቱ: ብእሲት — from his wife (እም- 'from' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', spelled -ቱ)
glossary.እምኔሁ: እም — from (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form እምኔ-) · 'than it', in comparison (ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ እምኔሁ 'a garment better than it')
glossary.እምኔየ: እም — than me (እም- + -ኔየ '1s me') · 'from me' (ትርሐቅ እምኔየ 'that you go far from me')
glossary.እስራኤላዊት: እስራኤላዊ — Israelite woman (relational adjective, fem. ዊት, from እስራኤል)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እባእ: ቦአ — I may enter (1cs subjunctive, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.እኁሁ: አኅ — brother (noun, base እኁ- before suffixes; + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እከየ: እከይ — evil (noun; construct 'evil of') · construct before its dependent noun (እከየ ምግባሪሁ 'the evil of his deeds')
glossary.እፈቅድ: ፈቀደ — I desire, wish (1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.እፌኑ: ፈነወ — I will send (1s imperfect, f-n-w)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኪያሃ: ኪያሃ — her (accusative independent pronoun, 3fs; object of ያኀድጉነ)
glossary.ክልኤ: ክልኤቱ — two (numeral; the short form ክልኤ before a noun)
glossary.ክልኤተ: ክልኤቱ — two (numeral; the form ክልኤተ before ስብረተ) · also before ሕዝበ (ክልኤተ ሕዝበ 'two peoples')
glossary.ወለአከ: ለአከ — and he sent (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወለአዝማዲሃ: ዘመድ — and to her kinsfolk (ወ- + ለ- + plural አዝማድ + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወለደ: ወለደ — he begot, bore (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
glossary.ወሕልቀተ: ሕልቀት — and a ring (ወ- + noun, fem., accusative)
glossary.ወሖረ: ሖረ — and he went (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወሖረት: ሖረ — and she went (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወሞተ: ሞተ — and he died (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-w-t)
glossary.ወርእዮ: ርእየ — and he saw him (ወ- + 3m sg perfect + -o, r-ʾ-y) · and seeing, and when he saw (ወ- + infinitive ርእዮ, circumstantial, with accusative object ዘንተ 'this')
glossary.ወቀተሎ: ቀተለ — and he killed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወበትረ: በትር — and rod of (ወ- + noun, construct) · and staff (ወ- + noun, accusative; ሕልቀተ ወበትረ 'ring and staff')
glossary.ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወተሐንጸት: ተሐንጸ — and it was built (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem passive of ሐነጸ 'build'; ፋርስ is the feminine subject)
glossary.ወተረሰየት: ተረሰየ — and she made herself, dressed herself (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem reflexive/passive of ረሰየ 'set, make')
glossary.ወተሰምዩ: ተሰምየ — and they were called (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem passive of ሰምየ 'name')
glossary.ወተስእሉ: ተስእለ — and they asked, inquired (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወተገልበበት: ተገልበበ — and she veiled herself, wrapped herself (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem, quadriliteral g-l-b-b) (?)
glossary.ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወትቤሎሙ: ይቤ — and she said to them (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of the irregular verb 'say' + ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወትዕማርሰ: ትዕማር — and Tamar, as for Tamar (ወ- + proper name + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወኀደጋ: ኀደገ — and he let her, left her (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወነሥአ: ነሥአ — and he took (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወነሥአት: ነሥአ — and she took (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወነበረት: ነበረ — and she sat, dwelt (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወነገርዋ: ነገረ — and they told her (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G + -ዋ '3fs her')
glossary.ወነገርዎ: ነገረ — and they told him (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, G + -ዎ 3ms object)
glossary.ወነግሠ: ነግሠ — and he reigned (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
glossary.ወንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and king of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወአተወ: አተወ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወአእተወ: አእተወ — and he brought in (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʾa-stem causative of አተወ 'enter')
glossary.ወአእተዋ: አእተወ — and he brought her in (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative + -ኣ '3fs her') (?)
glossary.ወአውፅአት: አውፅአ — and she brought out (ወ- + 3fs perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ወፅአ)
glossary.ወአዝማዲሃ: ዘመድ — and her kinsfolk (ወ- + plural አዝማድ + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወአግብኣ: አግብአ — and he sent her back (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ገብአ 'return' + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወኢታርኵስዋ: አርኰሰ — and do not defile her (ወ- + ኢ- + 2mp jussive, ʾa-stem causative of ረኰሰ 'be unclean' + -ዋ '3fs her')
glossary.ወኢይሰመይ: ተሰምየ — and that it not be called (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms jussive, tä-stem passive of ሰምየ 'name')
glossary.ወኢፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — and he did not wish (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወወሀበት: ወሀበ — and she gave (ወ- + 3fs perfect, w-h-b)
glossary.ወወሀባ: ወሀበ — and he gave her (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወዘርኡ: ዘርእ — and his seed (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', ዘርኡ)
glossary.ወዘበእንቲአሁ: በእንተ — and that which concerning him (ወ- + ዘ- 'that which' + በእንቲአ- 'concerning' + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
glossary.ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
glossary.ወይቤልዎሙ: ብህለ — and they said to them (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይውግሩኒ: ወገረ — and let them stone me (ወ- + 3mp subjunctive/jussive, G + -ኒ '1cs me'; read as 'let them', not a plain imperfect) (?)
glossary.ወገብኡ: ገብአ — and they returned (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወፈነወ: ፈነወ — and he sent (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, f-n-w)
glossary.ወፈነዎ: ፈነወ — and he sent him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, f-n-w + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዕቀብዋ: ዐቀበ — keep her! (2mp imperative, G + -ዋ '3fs her')
glossary.ዘማት: ዘማ — harlot (noun, fem.; singular, or a plural used generically (?); also 'fornication') (?)
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘአስሐተኒ: አስሐተ — who led me astray (ዘ- 'who' + 3ms perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ሰሐተ 'err' + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዚአሃ: ዚአ — hers, of her (possessive ዚአ + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ዝንቱአ: ዝንቱ — this, of this one (m. demonstrative + -ኣ) (?)
glossary.ያቅም: አቀመ — that he raise up, establish (3ms subjunctive, ʾa-stem causative of ቆመ 'stand', q-w-m)
glossary.ያወፅእ: አውፅአ — he brings out (3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem causative of ወፅአ 'go out')
glossary.ይልህቅ: ልህቀ — he is old, grown, elder (3ms imperfect, G, l-h-q; ለዘ ይልህቅ 'the elder')
glossary.ይሰክብ: ሰከበ — he lies (down), lies with (3ms imperfect, G, s-k-b)
glossary.ይቅርጽ: ቀረጸ — that he shear (3ms subjunctive, G, q-r-ṣ; ከመ ይቅርጽ 'to shear') (?)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይንእስ: ንእሰ — he is young (3ms imperfect, G, n-ʾ-s; ለዘ ይንእስ 'the younger')
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ዳተ: ዐጸድ — -ዳት, second half of አዕጻዳት 'folds, enclosures', split off by a stray wordspace (see አዕጻ) (?)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ገደፈት: ገደፈ — she cast off, threw off (3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ጠሊተ: ጠሊ — young animal, lamb or kid (?) (noun, accusative; the ending -ተ unexplained) (?)
glossary.ጠሌ: ጠሊ — kid, young goat (noun; spelling of ጠሊ)
glossary.ጸድቀት: ጸድቀ — she is righteous (3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ፀምረ: ጸምር — wool (noun, accusative; spelled with ፀ)
glossary.ፅንስተ: ፅንስት — pregnant (adjective/noun, fem., accusative ፅንስተ; 'one with child')
glossary.ፈረሳዊያን: ፈረሳዊ — Persians (?) (relational noun, plural ፈረሳዊያን; the reading 'Persians' is from context; the form is also 'horsemen' (cf. ፈረስ 'horse') or 'Pharisees', unsettled) (?)
glossary.ፋርስ: ፋርስ — Persia (proper name, land; dependent on the construct ንጉሠ 'king of Persia'; also subject, fem.)
glossary.ፋርስኒ: ፋርስ — Persia also (proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also, indeed')
glossary.፸፯: spoken ሰብዓ ወሰብዐቱ (säbʿa wä-säbʿatu) 'seventy-seven' — chapter number (numeral)
